items.title: Uruguay schuift Forlán naar voren na WK-debacle
items.summary: Diego Forlán krijgt voorlopig de leiding over de nationale ploeg van Uruguay. De Uruguayaanse voetbalbond heeft bevestigd dat de oud-topspits in elk geval tot maart volgend jaar de eindverantwoordelijke is bij de ploeg waar Marcelo Bielsa als bondscoach is vertrokken.

items.title: 'Aston Villa houdt Zwitserse WK-parel Manzambi uit handen van Newcastle'
items.summary: Niet Newcastle United, maar Aston Villa lijkt de nieuwe club van Johan Manzambi te worden, zo melden Engelse media. The Magpies bereikten al een akkoord met SC Freiburg, maar de Zwitserse WK-parel lijkt een voorkeur te hebben voor The Villans .

items.title: Kane sust relletje tussen Tuchel en Bellingham: 'Hij houdt ons scherp'
items.summary: Nog maar kort na de gewonnen kwartfinale tegen Noorwegen hadden de Engelse media al een rel te pakken. Jude Bellingham, die twee keer scoorde tegen de Noren, en bondscoach Thomas Tuchel waren het niet met elkaar eens over het wedstrijdbeeld en dat werd breed uitgemeten. Een dag later komt aanvoerder Harry Kane tussenbeide.

items.title: Infantino opens door to 64-team World Cup
items.summary: Plans for a 64-team men's world cup are set to be picked up and assessed in detail after the 2026 tournament with Fifa boss Gianni Infantino saying football needs to be "for the whole world".

items.summary: Captain Harry Kane says England "have another level we can reach" as they bid to win the World Cup for the first time since 1966.

items.title: ‘He just wants to see the best version of us’: Harry Kane accepts Tuchel criticism
items.summary: England head coach scathing after win against Norway Captain says comments will keep players on their toes Harry Kane has insisted Thomas Tuchel’s strong criticism of England’s performance after their quarter-final win against Norway in Miami was driven by their failure to bring their excellence from the training ground into matches. The England captain also suggested that Tuchel’s words had been designed to keep the players on their toes before the semi-final against Argentina in Atlanta on ­Wednesday because “he knows as much as ­anyone that it’s not as simple as that … he’s trying to drag it out of us”. Continue reading...

items.title: World Cup 2026 power rankings: who leads the pack as semi-finals loom?
items.summary: We assess the teams who played in the last eight as the business end of the tournament approaches Didier Deschamps has seen it all before and certainly does not fear even the lowest of blocks. It is clear everyone is afraid of Les Bleus, which is understandable, and they are using it to their advantage. It is admirable how teams keep France quiet for lengthy periods but the game is too long to completely silence Kylian Mbappé and Ousmane Dembélé. Against Morocco an hour of patience was required but these forwards are used to it and Mbappé produced the magic that has powered this run, following it up with an assist. In a tournament defined by individuals, France has the best of a talented bunch. Continue reading...

items.title: Big game Bellingham steps up again with show-stopping World Cup run for England | Andrew Beasley
items.summary: Real Madrid forward is thriving on the global stage as the first player to score twice in consecutive knockout matches at the tournament since Maradona in 1986 England’s World Cup journey has rapidly become the Jude Bellingham show. He scored twice to see off Norway on Saturday having also bagged a double in the previous round against Mexico. The 23-year-old attacking midfielder loves delivering on the biggest of stages. This is the greatest era of World Cup goal scoring, aided by the expansion of the tournament. The two leading scorers of all time are still in the 2026 edition, with Lionel Messi (21 goals) and Kylian Mbappé (20) joined by Harry Kane (14) in the top six. Erling Haaland scored seven times in only five matches, meaning he may be in the upper reaches of the chart by the time he retires, too. Continue reading...
